content: The Seven Angels with Seven Plagues
Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, because with them the wrath of God is completed.

content: and the sanctuary of the tent of witness in heaven was opened,
out came the seven angels with the seven
plagues. They were clothed in pure bright
linen, with golden sashes wrapped around their chests.
Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
